posts.text: [Image] A table titled “Immigrant Welfare Recipient Rates by Country of Origin” lists the percentage of immigrant households receiving assistance. Bhutan has the highest listed rate at 81.4%, followed by North Yemen at 75.2%, Somalia at 71.9%, and the Marshall Islands at 71.4%. The lowest rates shown are Cambodia at 49.9%, Cuba at 49.6%, and Laos at 49.2%.
